request.raw_text: Hi , Please change the center flower type profile into a hexagonal profile for better torque transfer

aim.primary_aim: Replace the center flower-type profile with a hexagonal profile that provides better torque transfer.

functional_design_intentions.name: Improved torque transfer
functional_design_intentions.description: The center profile should transfer torque more effectively through its hexagonal form.

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: all geometry outside the center profile
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all non-targeted geometry and design relationships under a minimum-change rule.

geometry.description: A hexagonal profile exists at the center in place of the former flower-type profile; the flower-type profile is absent.

functions.name: Torque transfer
functions.description: The center hexagonal profile provides better torque transfer than the replaced flower-type profile.

behaviors.name: Rotational engagement
behaviors.description: The hexagonal profile engages mating geometry through planar sides and corners to resist relative rotational slipping and transmit torque.

validation_criteria.description: The former flower-type profile is absent from the center.
The center hexagonal profile supports improved torque transfer.
The center profile provides positive rotational engagement intended to resist relative slipping during torque transmission.
Non-targeted geometry and existing design relationships remain unchanged.

The hexagonal profile's size, orientation, depth or extent, and mating-fit requirements are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Derive the hexagonal profile envelope and extent from the existing center profile
Match an unspecified mating hexagonal component
Use separately defined torque and fit requirements
